title: Bounded finite-group Wasm computation
objective: Profile finite-group public workloads and accelerate one representative heavy permutation-group computation through a bounded source-transparent packed Wasm kernel with exact fallback, differential, route, Node/browser, and benchmark evidence

handoff.summary: Adds a bounded source-transparent packed kernel for the cold degree-8 public permutation-group center workflow, exact portable fallback and route evidence, direct Wasm and public Node/browser proofs, and a representative benchmark.
risks: The real-browser proof requires the shared production Python package graph and native-kernel manifest to include sagejs.kernels.groups.permutation; those shared integration files are intentionally owned by the root lane.
test:baselib:strict inherits unrelated builtins.py type errors from the base commit.
next_steps: Register packed_permutation_center in the shared native manifest and precompiled Python package graph, regenerate production assets, then run the full browser proof.
Add the public S8 center example and exact route record to the shared acceptance corpus.
